voice.name: Open Sector - Cyborg
voice.description: Deep male voice of a half-human half-machine soldier, heavily processed and metallic with a cold synthetic edge, slow, flat and menacing, every word clipped like a machine reading a kill order, a faint mechanical rasp and buzz under the voice, utterly fearless and dryly grim.
voice.sample: Cyborg unit online. Ammunition drum at full capacity. Target acquired. Flesh is weak, steel is patient. I will walk through your fire and I will not stop.

fire.prompt: Short burst from an electric gatling gun arm, rapid spinning barrels firing very fast, mechanical whir spin-up and spin-down, close, outdoors battlefield, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Cyborg soldier walking: servo motor whine and hydraulic hiss with heavy metallic footsteps on dirt, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Cyborg destroyed: electrical sparks crackling, short circuit buzz, servo powering down, heavy metal body collapsing onto the ground, close, no music, no voice

shutdown.prompt: Cyborg soldier shutting down: a descending electric power-down whine, servo motors winding down and stalling, a last relay click and a hiss of hydraulics as heavy metal limbs sag and lock, a fading electronic hum, close, no music, no voice

reboot.prompt: Cyborg soldier rebooting under a new command signal: a quick digital chirp sequence, a rising electric power-up whine, servo motors spinning up and limbs locking into place with heavy metallic clunks, close, no music, no voice
